fn countSquares(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a >= 0)
  requires (b >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if ((a == 0) or (b == 0)) then 0 else if (a > b) then ((a / b) + countSquares((a % b), b)) else ((b / a) + countSquares(a, (b % a)))))
  ensures ((not (((a > 0) and (b > 0)) and (a > b))) or (result >= 1))
  ensures ((not (((a > 0) and (b > 0)) and (b > a))) or (result >= 1))
  ensures ((not (((a > 0) and (b > 0)) and (a == b))) or (result == 1))
  effects pure
  example (countSquares(0, 0) == 0)
  example (countSquares(1, 1) == 1)
{
  if ((a == 0) or (b == 0)) then 0 else if (a > b) then ((a / b) + countSquares((a % b), b)) else ((b / a) + countSquares(a, (b % a)))
}

fn solve(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a > 0)
  requires (b > 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not (a == b)) or (result == 1))
  ensures ((not (a > b)) or (result >= 1))
  ensures (result == countSquares(a, b))
